title: KU ROTC will host 2026 KU 9/11 Memorial Stair Climb
summary_en: The University of Kansas Reserve Officer Training Corps programs will host the 2026 KU 9/11 Memorial Stair Climb on Sept. 11 at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium to honor and remember the courage and sacrifice of the firefighters, first responders and service members who responded on Sept. 11, 2001.
title_cn: KU ROTC will host 2026 KU 9/11 Memorial Stair Climb

title: KU launches website dedicated to businesses
summary_en: The website, partner.ku.edu, serves as a gateway to KU’s business-focused resources, connecting employers with world-class research, core laboratories, workforce training and top talent.
title_cn: KU launches website dedicated to businesses

title: KU to host summit on Indigenous food sovereignty
summary_en: The Office of Sovereign Partnerships & Indigenous Initiatives at the University of Kansas and partners will host a daylong summit Sept. 16 featuring a keynote by alumna Lois Stevens (Oneida Nation) and several panel sessions along with a screening of “Seed Warriors,” a film by KU faculty member Rebekka Schlichting (Ioway Tribe of Kansas and Nebraska).
title_cn: KU to host summit on Indigenous food sovereignty

title: KU Transportation Center keeps Kansans connected
summary_en: The KU Transportation Center supports the roads, routes and relationships that strengthen the Sunflower State. Part of the School of Engineering, the center has partnered with transportation professionals, transit providers and local governments throughout Kansas.
title_cn: KU Transportation Center keeps Kansans connected
